Wird

Self-hosted F-Droid repo for Wird, a minimal daily Quran reading habit tracker. Add this repo URL in the F-Droid client to get automatic updates.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://afnanpvt.github.io/wird/repo
